# Imperium

> A local pre-alpha supervisor for AI coding builders: durable delivery outcomes, acknowledged feeds, explicit
> completion claims, snapshot verification and principal-controlled acceptance. Uncertainty is recorded, not
> silently retried. Evidence and capabilities depend on the adapter.

- Python 3.11+, Git, SQLite; the control service has no mandatory third-party Python dependency.
- Verification defaults to restricted Docker/Linux containers with an owner-prepared pinned image, no host fallback.
- OpenCode 1.18.32 has small published demonstrations over HTTP and ACP. Other ACP products remain unvalidated targets.
- HTTP observes subagents; ACP reports subagent visibility as unknown and readiness at the active-session scope.
- stop-all pauses dispatch. abort-all requests cancellation and reports per-builder outcomes; detached processes may survive.
- Same-user owner/director credentials remain cooperative boundaries. Separate builder isolation is still needed.
- No comparative real-task productivity or reliability improvement is claimed.
